title: Reported Speech 0 – Überblick: Was ändert sich?
description: Verben, Pronomen sowie Zeit & Ort in der direkten Rede markieren

items.text: Terry told Sally, “I flew to London yesterday.”
items.hint: Terry told Sally that he had flown to London the day before.

items.text: Ben promised, “I will finish my homework tomorrow.”
items.hint: Ben promised that he would finish his homework the next day.

items.text: Lisa said, “We were in Paris last year.”
items.hint: Lisa said that they had been in Paris the year before.

items.text: “I have been waiting for you for two hours,” she complained.
items.hint: She complained that she had been waiting for him for two hours. – Zeitdauern mit „for“ bleiben unverändert.

items.text: “You are doing a great job,” Greta said to me.
items.hint: Greta told me that I was doing a great job. – „me“ steht im Erzählsatz außerhalb der Anführungszeichen und ändert sich nicht.

items.text: Mum said to me, “You can meet me here today.”
items.hint: Mum told me that I could meet her there that day. – Das „me“ im Erzählsatz (said to me) bleibt, das „me“ in der wörtlichen Rede wird zu her.

items.text: Max said, “My sister is working in this office now.”
items.hint: Max said that his sister was working in that office then. – this → that gehört zu „Zeit & Ort“.

items.text: The boys said, “We saw them two days ago.”
items.hint: The boys said that they had seen them two days before. – „them“ meint andere Personen und bleibt unverändert.
